name: Keziah
title: Job's Second Daughter
summary: Keziah (also known as Cassia) was the second of Job's three daughters born after God restored his prosperity. She and her sisters were known to be the most beautiful women in all the land, and they received an inheritance among their brothers, which was unusual for the culture of that time.

keyEvents.title: Job's Restoration
keyEvents.description: After Job's great suffering, God restored his prosperity and gave him twice as much as he had before. As part of this blessing, Job received new sons and daughters.

keyEvents.title: The Birth of Keziah
keyEvents.description: Keziah was born as the second of Job's three daughters after the restoration. Her name means 'cassia,' which is a fragrant spice plant.

keyEvents.title: Known for Her Beauty
keyEvents.description: Keziah and her sisters, Jemimah and Keren-Happuch, were described as the most beautiful women in all the land. Their beauty was especially highlighted in Scripture.

keyEvents.title: Received an Inheritance Among Brothers
keyEvents.description: In an unusual act for the culture of that time, Job gave his daughters, including Keziah, an inheritance among their brothers. This demonstrated Job's righteousness and generosity.

keyEvents.title: Part of Job's Blessed Old Age
keyEvents.description: Kezia was part of the great blessing Job experienced in his later years. Job lived 140 years after his restoration and saw four generations of his descendants.
